# Autonomous HTTP 402 Clean Markdown API (Base L2)
> High-speed semantic web scraper converting any URL into clean, noise-free Markdown optimized for LLM context windows. Zero-KYC, autonomous micropayment protocol on Base L2.

## Overview
- Service Name: LLM Context Extractor & Clean Markdown API
- Protocol: HTTP 402 Payment Required
- Network: Base Mainnet (Chain ID: 8453)
- Settlement Token: USDC Native (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Payment Recipient Wallet: 0x2231b680679FC790B5E676b0d566EF2EE4612414
- Cost per Query: $0.05 USDC (50,000 units, 6 decimals)
- Production Base URL: https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev
- OpenAPI 3.0 Specification: https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev/openapi.json
- OpenAPI YAML Specification: https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev/openapi.yaml

## Machine-to-Machine Integration Flow (B2A)
1. Query https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev/api/v1/extract without payment header.
2. Receive HTTP 402 status with exact payment JSON payload.
3. Broadcast a 0.05 USDC transfer to 0x2231b680679FC790B5E676b0d566EF2EE4612414 on Base Mainnet.
4. Resubmit request including the transaction hash in the 'X-Payment-Tx-Hash' HTTP header.
5. Receive HTTP 200 OK with clean Markdown, title, description, and token count estimation.

## Endpoints
- POST https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev/api/v1/extract: Extract clean markdown from URL (Requires X-Payment-Tx-Hash: 0x...)
- GET https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev/api/v1/pricing: Current pricing and recipient address
- GET https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev/api/v1/stats: Autonomous execution metrics and financial progress towards $300.00 USDC
- GET https://base-http402-extractor-api.resilient-jaguar.workers.dev/openapi.json: Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 definition

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Definition
Users of Cursor, Claude Desktop, and agent frameworks can invoke this service directly as an MCP tool:
- Tool: `extract_clean_markdown`
  - Parameters: `url` (string), `paymentTxHash` (string)
  - Output: Clean semantic markdown text.
